system.description: Shattered Veil: You have a connection with another Entity of your choice from the Entities of Void Sheet. When you summon it, you gain the Manifest benefit of that Entity. You can still only have one summoned Entity active at any given time; summoning a new Entity immediately dismisses the currently active one.

attribution.source: The New Unknown Playtest v3.0 Fist

system.gmNotes: Dismiss the previous Entity's token by hand.
